changes.description: Updated the Chart of Callings to reflect renamed and optional callings across the handbook.

changes.title: Participation in Unusual Circumstances
changes.description: Added two paragraphs clarifying procedures when a stake president or bishop is unable to participate in a membership council due to unusual circumstances.

changes.title: Dedicating Buildings
changes.description: Added conditions under which leased buildings may be dedicated for worship.

changes.title: Unwed Parents under Age 18
changes.description: Added policy allowing unwed parents under age 18 to participate either in youth classes/quorums or in Elders Quorum/Relief Society at the discretion of the youth, parents, and bishop.

changes.title: Policies on Moral Issues
changes.description: Added preface explaining that members usually do not face membership restrictions for decisions on matters the Church discourages, while remaining accountable to God.

changes.title: Birth Control
changes.description: Merged surgical sterilization into the birth control section; maintained counsel discouraging elective surgical sterilization while encouraging couples to counsel together in unity.

changes.title: Donation of Sperm or Eggs
changes.description: Expanded former sperm donation policy to cover donating or selling sperm or eggs; discouraged donation or sale while leaving donation decisions to the donor’s prayerful judgment.

changes.title: Fertility Treatments
changes.description: Merged artificial insemination and in vitro fertilization into a new Fertility Treatments section; discouraged using donor sperm or eggs while leaving decisions to married couples.

changes.title: The Occult
changes.description: Clarified that the occult includes Satan worship, fortune-telling, curses, and healing practices that imitate priesthood power.

changes.title: Sex Education
changes.description: Encouraged parents to have honest, ongoing conversations with their children about righteous sexuality and to stay informed about school sex education.

changes.title: Suicide
changes.description: Expanded counsel on ministering with sensitivity and professional support to those considering suicide, noting that only God can judge a person’s thoughts, actions, and accountability.

changes.title: Surrogate Motherhood
changes.description: Added policy that children born to a surrogate mother may be sealed to parents in a temple only with First Presidency approval.

changes.title: Medical Marijuana
changes.description: Added section opposing nonmedical marijuana use while outlining guidelines for authorized medical marijuana use.

changes.title: Questions about Instructions
changes.description: Updated instructions on directing handbook questions to presiding authorities.

changes.title: Communication (Public Affairs)
changes.description: Updated stake presidency duties regarding public affairs and community communication.

changes.title: Stake Relief Society, Young Women, Primary, and Sunday School Presidencies
changes.description: Updated guidelines for stake Relief Society, Young Women, Primary, and Sunday School presidencies.

changes.description: Updated guidelines for the stake Young Men presidency.

changes.title: Stake Sunday School Presidency
changes.description: Updated guidelines for the stake Sunday School presidency.

changes.title: Stake Organization Secretaries
changes.description: Updated guidelines for stake organization secretaries.

changes.title: Chapter 10: Aaronic Priesthood Quorums
changes.description: Rewrote chapter around the work of salvation and exaltation; added the 2019 Aaronic Priesthood quorum theme, the Children and Youth program, and stronger emphasis on youth quorum presidency leadership.

changes.title: Chapter 11: Young Women
changes.description: Rewrote chapter around the work of salvation and exaltation; added the 2019 Young Women theme, the Children and Youth program, and stronger emphasis on youth class presidency leadership.

changes.title: Chapter 12: Primary
changes.description: Rewrote chapter around the work of salvation and exaltation; added the Children and Youth program, restroom safety guidelines, and a rule that youth do not teach Primary even as substitutes.

changes.title: Approval to Administer the Sacrament
changes.description: Updated guidelines on priesthood approval to administer the sacrament.

changes.description: Updated responsibilities of assistant stake clerks.

changes.description: Updated responsibilities of assistant ward clerks.

changes.title: Membership Records
changes.description: Updated policies and procedures for membership records.

changes.title: Abuse Help Line
changes.description: Updated instructions for bishops and stake presidents on using the Church’s Abuse Help Line.

changes.title: Counseling in Cases of Abuse
changes.description: Updated guidance on counseling victims and offenders in cases of abuse.

changes.title: Adoption and Foster Care
changes.description: Updated policy and referral information on adoption and foster care.

changes.title: Introductory Overview
changes.description: Introduced the consolidated digital General Handbook replacing Handbook 1 and Handbook 2.

changes.chapterTitle: God’s Plan and Your Role in the Work of Salvation and Exaltation
changes.title: God’s Plan and Your Role in the Work of Salvation and Exaltation
changes.description: Added foundational chapter outlining God’s plan of happiness and the fourfold work of salvation and exaltation.

changes.chapterTitle: Supporting Individuals and Families in the Work of Salvation and Exaltation
changes.title: Supporting Individuals and Families in the Work of Salvation and Exaltation
changes.description: Added chapter on the role of the family and home-centered gospel living and support from the Church.

changes.title: Priesthood Principles
changes.description: Rewrote chapter on priesthood authority, keys, covenants, and how delegated priesthood power blesses women, men, and children.

changes.chapterTitle: Leadership in the Church of Jesus Christ
changes.title: Leadership in the Church of Jesus Christ
changes.description: Rewrote chapter on Christlike leadership, spiritual preparation, counseling together, building unity, and delegation.

changes.title: Seminaries and Institutes of Religion
changes.description: Rewrote chapter on Seminary and Institute programs and references to Church schools and BYU–Pathway Worldwide.

changes.title: Priesthood Ordinances and Blessings
changes.description: Rewrote chapter on performing priesthood ordinances and blessings with step-by-step instructions and video links.

changes.title: Repentance and Church Membership Councils
changes.description: Rewrote former Church Discipline chapter; replaced disciplinary councils, disfellowshipment, and excommunication with membership councils, formal membership restrictions, and withdrawal of membership.

changes.chapterTitle: Creating, Changing, and Naming New Units
changes.title: Creating, Changing, and Naming New Units
changes.description: Rewrote chapter on creating, adjusting, and naming stakes, districts, wards, and branches.

changes.title: Specialized Stakes, Wards, and Branches
changes.description: Rewrote chapter on organizing units for specific languages, students, single members, care facilities, and special circumstances.

changes.title: Policies on Moral Issues
changes.description: Consolidated and updated moral policies from former handbooks and added a new section on individuals who identify as transgender (38.6.23).
